term.ba.airprotect.desc.text: Reduces Physical and Arts damage taken from aerial units by a certain percentage (does not stack with Sanctuary effects of the same name, highest value applies)

term.ba.dt.rampage.desc.text: When Manic Damage reaches 1000, grants ASPD +50 for 15 seconds, but takes 100 True damage per second (increases by 50 each time the unit attacks, up to 600)

term.ba.groundbind.desc.text: The target becomes a ground unit and cannot Move; forces certain Low-Altitude Hovering enemies to fall; duration halved against units with Weight greater than 3

term.ba.magicarcane.desc.text: Increases Arts damage dealt (does not stack, highest value applies)

term.ba.sees.desc.text: Includes Makoto Yuki, Aigis, Yukari Takeba, and Koromaru

term.ba.triggereffect.desc.text: A one-time buff/debuff applied to an allied/enemy unit that only triggers when specific conditions are met
